# Data manifest: what the WRDS extracts contained when the results of record were produced

The extracts are licensed and are not in the repository; the raw sample accompanies the report on CloudDeakin.
Script 02 writes each extract sorted by its natural key, so the MD5 identifies the content. Pulled 12 October 2026;
manifest written 13 October 2026 by manifest_rows() in code/00_helpers.R. Script 03 recomputes every line below for the files
on disk and writes `docs/data_manifest_check.md`: PASS where they agree, and for a later pull the fiscal years
and items where the counts moved (Compustat is revised, so a fresh pull is expected to differ at the margin).
